name: ML Pipeline Orchestration (Kubeflow, Flyte, Argo)
description: Workflow scheduling and orchestration for ML pipelines: Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP v2), Flyte, Argo Workflows, Metaflow, containerized components, caching, GPU node selectors, and fault tolerance.

subskills.name: Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP v2) & @dsl Component Authoring
subskills.description: Authoring KFP v2 pipelines with @dsl.component, @dsl.pipeline, container_component, passing Input/Output artifacts, and pipeline compilation.

subskills.name: Flyte Type-Safe Workflow Orchestration
subskills.description: Flyte tasks (@task) and workflows (@workflow), strong type checking, FlyteFile/FlyteDirectory, dynamic workflows, and Flytekit SDK.

subskills.name: Argo Workflows Declarative YAML Pipelines
subskills.description: Kubernetes CRD-based workflow orchestration, Argo WorkflowTemplate, steps, DAG templates, volume mounts, and artifact repositories.

subskills.name: Pipeline Step Caching & Memoization
subskills.description: Configuring step memoization keys in KFP / Flyte, reusing cached outputs for unchanged steps, and speeding up pipeline iterations.

subskills.name: GPU Resource Allocation & Node Affinity in Pipelines
subskills.description: Setting container resource requests/limits (nvidia.com/gpu: 1), tolerations for tainted GPU nodes, and nodeAffinity selectors in pipeline tasks.

subskills.name: Apache Airflow for ML Orchestration & Providers
subskills.description: Airflow providers (Astronomer Cosmos for dbt/ML, Amazon SageMaker operators, Google Vertex AI operators), and triggering external ML training jobs.

subskills.name: Pipeline Error Handling, Retries & Fallbacks
subskills.description: Configuring task retry policies, exponential backoff, on_exit handler steps for cleanup, and alerting notifications upon pipeline failures.

subskills.name: Kubeflow Training Operator (PyTorchJob, TFJob)
subskills.description: Deploying PyTorchJob and TFJob Custom Resources for multi-node distributed training, master/worker pods, and gang scheduling with Volcano.

subskills.name: Metaflow Deployment to Argo Workflows / AWS Step Functions
subskills.description: Compiling Metaflow workflows to Argo Workflows (metaflow argo-workflows create) or AWS Step Functions for scheduled production execution.

cv.signal: Engineered distributed ML pipelines on Kubeflow Pipelines and Flyte with GPU dynamic scheduling and step caching

linkedin.signal: Kubeflow, Flyte, and ML Pipeline Orchestration endorsements

assessment.signal: Passes ML Pipeline Orchestration (Kubeflow, Flyte, Argo) Technical Assessment

junior.description: Authors basic KFP v2 pipelines with @dsl.component, configures step caching, and schedules runs via Airflow.

mid.description: Develops type-safe workflows in Flyte, writes Argo WorkflowTemplates, manages GPU node affinities, and implements retry policies.

senior.description: Architects multi-node PyTorchJob training clusters with gang scheduling and compiles enterprise workflows to Argo / Step Functions.
